cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You lost the chess game; you wash up. I taught you to shake hands and pay the stake before asking for another game.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we were joking about the dishes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You explained my washing-up duties very clearly while you were winning. That part of your game has improved. The sink's still there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you've washed those plates. I'll set the pieces up while you finish; you can practise the ending I taught you before we start another opening.

reason: Ground the exact paired behavior in remembered pupil habits and a specific immediate ask. Complete all three measurement/gain/rank dimensions where required, and keep unrevealed stakes visibly withheld rather than inventing them.
